name: Deeg–Govardhan District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 70, Deeg–Govardhan District road, crosses the border between Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Rajasthan PWD and UP PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
